Menu.Name: Module Diagnostics
Menu.Label: Open diagnostics dashboard
Menu.Hint: Collect bounded client-side evidence, inspect packages, run compatibility scans, and export redacted reports. Game Masters always have access; selected players can be granted their own client diagnostics.

BackgroundCapture.Name: Capture background runtime errors
BackgroundCapture.Hint: Records bounded browser/runtime error evidence after startup. Console method interception is enabled only during focused capture; existing browser-console history cannot be recovered.

MaxEntries.Name: Maximum captured entries
MaxEntries.Hint: Oldest entries are discarded when this client-side ring buffer is full.

CaptureLongTasks.Name: Capture long tasks
CaptureLongTasks.Hint: Records browser long-task performance entries where supported.

CustomRedactions.Name: Additional exact redaction terms
CustomRedactions.Hint: One sensitive term per line. Terms are replaced in exported reports.

Notifications.ImportTooLarge: The selected evidence file exceeds the 5 MB limit.
Notifications.ImportFailed: The evidence file could not be imported.
Notifications.SelectModuleFirst: Select at least one active module first.
Notifications.NotAuthorized: Runyth Module Diagnostics is not enabled for your Foundry user. Ask the Game Master to grant player diagnostics access.
Notifications.GmOnlyAccess: Only a Game Master can change player diagnostics access.
Notifications.AccessSaved: Player diagnostics access saved for {count} user(s).

Access.Title: Player diagnostics access
Access.Description: Choose the non-GM users who may open Runyth Module Diagnostics and collect evidence from their own browser client.
Access.FilterPlaceholder: Filter by player name or user ID
Access.NoPlayers: No non-GM Foundry users are available in this world.
Access.PlayerNotice: Player diagnostics mode: evidence, imports, scans, and reports stay in this browser unless you explicitly export and send a report ZIP.
Access.HowItWorksOwnClient: Each authorized player has an independent in-memory evidence buffer and client-local window/settings state.
Access.HowItWorksNoUpload: The module does not send player diagnostics to the Game Master, a server endpoint, or a third party automatically.
Access.HowItWorksImmediate: Access changes apply to connected clients when the world setting synchronizes; a browser reload is a safe fallback if Foundry has not refreshed the setting yet.
Access.HowItWorksGmAlways: Game Masters always retain diagnostics access and cannot lock themselves out with this list.
Access.PrivacyText: Authorized players receive the diagnostics workflow, not Game Master privileges. They cannot change this access list through the dashboard.
